positions.title: Consultant, Business Technology Integration
positions.description:
Tools: MS SQL Server (T-SQL, SSMS, DTS, SSIS, SSRS), .NET (ASP, C#, VB, Visual Studio, TFS), MS Office (Access, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio)

Designed and built backend and frontend architecture to automate GNMA reporting process, resulting in a 95% reduction in production time, allowing Bank of America to comply with GNMA requirements.

Developed application to automate FHLMC accounting process: 50% reduction in process time; reduction in monthly unidentified write-offs from +-$500,000 to +-$50,000.

Upgraded multiple reports from MS Access to SSIS and SSRS, decreasing report creation times from 50 – 95%.

Team member of small team charged with converting hundreds of DTS packages to SSIS packages. Upgraded the SSIS packages to be used in front end application by Business, resulting in >90% reduction in support hours needed from Technology team.

Team member on Proof of Concept (POC) team moving rules engine from SQL to JRules. Successful POC with 25% increase in throughput of loans through decisioning process.

Analyze business processes, design and implement solutions to improve both efficiency and accuracy.

Participate in all stages of the software development life cycle (Waterfall model and Agile model).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tools: MS SQL Server (T-SQL, SSMS), VB6, VB.NET, VSS, SVN

Program and support data driven fraud detection software.

Using proprietary software, created file specific automated ETL procedures for over 100 customers and 250 files.

Analyze existing software to locate bugs, develop new functions and improve performance.

Communicate highly technical issues with project managers and clients.

Provide continued SQL and VB training to Technical Services Team.
